pages.title: Star Palace Capital
pages.text: This entry follows region_cards/star_palace_city.json, merchant_shops.json#star_palace_merit_hall, and sect_contribution_shop.json#star_palace. It reuses existing region and merit-shop data without adding NPCs, an auction UI, a patrol-board UI, a quest loader, or extra network packets.

pages.title: Current Region
pages.text: Heavenstar City is available as star_palace_city with a 1.45 aura multiplier, a Foundation Establishment entry requirement, and star_palace_city_anchor for travel. Its tags are sea, star_palace, auction, and patrol_board; auctions and the patrol board remain future system hooks.

pages.title: Merit Stock
pages.text: The Star Palace Merit Hall currently spends sect contribution through ShopService. Its Essence-Condensing Pill listing uses an Essence-Condensing Pill for 8000 contribution, stock 1; its formula uses the matching jade slip for 1200, stock 2; and the Soul-Nurturing Formula uses a Soul-Gathering Pill jade slip for 600.

pages.title: Sea-Route Supplies
pages.text: Available sea-route supplies are sea_calm_pill and recipe_sea_calm. The first reuses a low-tier mind-clearing pill for 80 contribution, stock 15, restocking every 24000 ticks; the second reuses a Qingxin Pill jade slip for 40 contribution. Teleport permits, patrol orders, and Void Palace map fragments are not yet usable items.

pages.title: Planned Content
pages.text: Star Palace reputation gates, monthly or per-player limits, auction schedules, patrol quests, teleport permits, Void Palace map fragments, Star Palace NPCs, sea-event rewards, and an FTB Quests chapter are not yet implemented. This page describes only existing region and contribution-shop hooks.
